{{Quote|We've had some trouble with the power relays. I need to check on the computer core. You mind?|Gorry|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Gorry''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He and his droid [[4-SEN]] were stationed in the Separatist's Database warehouse at [[Mannett Point]] when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] broke in and killed an number of soldiers there.<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Gorry was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on the Republic held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Planets">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>. He was a member of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], a group who opposed the planet's corrupt [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|central government]] on their support of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and wished to be independent. Whilst Gorry worked for them they were engaged in the [[Separatist War]] with the government and the [[Republic Army]].

Gorry and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[4-SEN]] were stationed for part of the war on the Separatist held island of [[Mannett Point]]. There they were amongst the soilders who guarded the Separatist's personnel database which was kept in a captured warehouse on the island. During the time they were there the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] broke into the warehouse with help from a inhabitant of Mannett point named [[Reki]]. The Smuggler intended to download all the data from the database and use it to locate a Separatist named [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] who had stolen his ship and a shipment of weapons from [[Rendia Freight]]. The Smuggler successfully reached the database after killing a number of the guards in the warehouse.

As the Smuggler was downloading the data 4-SEN's sensor's detected the bodies of the guards he killed and so put the warehouse's alert status on red while informing Gorry. The droid could not however detect any hostiles not realizing that Ace was an intruder. The smuggler asked Gorry when he had last calibrated 4-SEN's sensors and persuaded him they were most likely faulty and so there was no need for an alarm. Gorry agreed and he and 4-SEN moved on allowing the Smuggler to successfully complete his task and escape.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
During his time as a separatist Gorry wore the standard [[Color/Legends|red]] and yellow armor and clothes of the separatists troopers. He was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] which he wore at his hip.

==Behind the scenes==
Gorry is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is a character involved in the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] classes storyline quest appearing in one mission. It is possible for the Smuggler to simply attack and kill Gorry and 4-SEN as a dark side option instead of persuading them to move on. It is impossible for players of any other faction to interact with or see Gorry unless they are in a party with a smuggler completing the mission.<ref name="TOR" />
